rows.en: Defeat all Phantom Soldiers!
Defeat all Phantom Soldiers! Also search for the space kaiju Bemular sleeping at the bottom of the lake!
Defeat the space kaiju Bemular, Toge Banbara and all Phantom Soldiers!

Welcome…

Oh, it's just you guys!?
Don't look so disappointed. We're perfectly good customers too, you know.
Anyway… something smells great. Oyassan, is that curry?
Yep, I was thinking of putting it on the shop's lunch menu. I tried making an Amigo Special Curry. Oh, right, give it a taste for me.
Ooh… Oyassan's special curry, huh?
Come to think of it… I don't see [HERO2] and the others.
Ah, [HERO2]'s gone out. Said he was heading over toward Shinjuku. Something about…

Ah, [HERO2] went out to see a movie with [HERO4].

For once, [HERO2] was the one who asked… What was that movie called again? I think it was…

…!?

Is that a steam locomotive?
That's odd. No trains run anywhere near here… But that's definitely the sound of a steam locomotive.
Wh… what is that thing? It's just like a steam locomotive. It's coming this way!

Chugga-chugga choo-choo… chugga-chugga choo-choo!

Sorry, but give me some water! I'm overheating a bit.

Ah…!?

Yes, yes… Water, right?
Sorry, pour it for me!
Another glass!
Who are you? A Gel-Shocker monster?
My name is… Locomotive Mask of the Black Cross Army!
The Black Cross Army? What are you up to? Why are you running around?

That is a Black Cross Army secret! I can't tell you!!

Much obliged, thanks for your help! Departuuure, full steam aheaaad!!
Hey, wait!! Who are this Black Cross Army?
Wait, Hayato! Not here, it's a bad idea…

But… I've never heard of any organization called the Black Cross Army, and there's no way they're on our side!

Besides… did you see his feet? That was an underground detector! He's definitely up to no good!
Hmm… The Black Cross Army. Has a new enemy appeared!? We'd better report this to the TDF too.
Don't look so disappointed. We're perfectly good customers too, you know.
Anyway… something smells great. Oyassan, is that curry?
Ooh… Oyassan's special curry, huh?
Come to think of it… I don't see [HERO2] and the others.

…!?

Is that a steam locomotive?
Wh… what is that thing? It's just like a steam locomotive. It's coming this way!
Who are you? A Gel-Shocker monster?
The Black Cross Army? What are you up to? Why are you running around?
Hey, wait!! Who are this Black Cross Army?
Wait, Hongo! Not here, it's a bad idea…

But… I've never heard of any organization called the Black Cross Army, and there's no way they're on our side!

Besides… did you see his feet? That was an underground detector! He's definitely up to no good!
The war between the international defense organization EAGLE and the Black Cross Army, which schemes to conquer the world, was growing larger by the day.
For EAGLE's members, the Black Cross Army's Mask Monsters were terrifying foes, but they had the mightiest of guardians on their side.
EAGLE's proud elite five… the invincible warriors, Gorenger.
Now, carrying out a vital mission, the Gorengers had blended into the crowds of Shinjuku.
There are so many people, aren't there?
Yeah… No matter how many invaders and evil organizations attack, people's lives don't change all that much.
That means our battles are helping people that much… doesn't it?
Still… this area sure has changed a lot while we were away from Earth.

…!?

What is that sound?
"That's a steam locomotive…" "No way… a steam locomotive in a place like this?"
That's bugging me. All right, let's go check it out!
Probably some kind of event. Don't worry about it…
Yes… Um, [HERO2]. I would like to go over there…
Hm!? Where do you want to go?
That tallest building.
That's the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building. Why would you want to go there?
That building… is surely hiding a system that transforms it into a giant robot.

Huh!?

What are you talking about, [HERO4]?
Mr. Tachibana told me. He said that building is Japan's ultimate defense weapon. I would very much like to see it!
H-hold on, [HERO4]!! H-heeey!!
Satisfied now, [HERO4]?

Yes…

Optical, infrared, temperature change, gravitational fluctuation, magnetic survey… according to the results of every scan…

that building does not transform into a robot!

Good, so you get it now…

You… were you hoping it really was a giant robot?
I wanted to see it. A 243-meter giant robot…
Well, sure, I get that. But Oyassan never says anything useful…

Hm!?

That steam locomotive sound again! This is definitely weird… Something's going on! Let's go, [HERO4]!!
That banana crepe was yummy, huh?
They say there's always room for dessert, but… you sure can eat, huh?
Hehehe… My feet just carry me there on their own, you know. Like, "Ah, this feeling"…
…And that "feeling"… which shop is it carrying you to next?

[HERO2], you meanie… Huh?

A steam train? No way! In the middle of the city?
That is strange. Not even regular trains run around here…
Did I hear wrong?
"No… I definitely heard it." "Figures… A steam train in a place like this?"
That's bugging me… Let's go take a look!
Maybe it's some event? "New! Steam Train Parfait!!" Just kidding…
Yeah, yeah.
Anyway, that movie was fun… The hero, Takuma, was so cool, right? You thought so too, didn't you, [HERO4]?

I mean… I didn't even want to see "Super Tokusatsu Taisen 2001"…

And honestly, [HERO2], that's just so [HERO2] of you, inviting me to a movie like that… I wanted something more, like… how do I put it? A touching story about two lovers or something…
Come on, quit complaining! I always go along with what you want, [HERO4], don't I? Just this once is fine, isn't it?
I am happy you invited me, though~ Ah… then, [HERO2], so you don't get lost…
Wh… whoa, stop!? Quit it! People are watching!

uncertain: U03456: 寵のランチ unclear; read as 店のランチ (the shop's lunch menu).
U03497/U03522: narration rows holding two quoted speakers; kept as two quoted lines.
U03526: the movie's hero is named タクマ (the default hero name, a meta joke). Kept 'Takuma' because the row has no [HERO2] tag and adding one would change the tag set; reviewer may want to revisit.
U03529: line trails off (she grabs his arm, per U03530).
